attBesluta.text: Bought this item for my daughter's show pens for her goats and sheep and they are great!! Easy to put together and easy to hang 10/10

*** I have to edit my review. I would not recommend this for goats because goats have no respect for nice things. They climb on it to pull all of the hay out. Climb in it and get stuck. Climbing in it also rips it off the wall. One goat will claim ownership and not let the other near it. Get rid of the goats and get sheep and this will be fine. I would suggest buying the bigger model on a stand for goats. Nothing is wrong with this product but it is not suited to goats. *** Very solid and easy to put together. Great design as the dropped hay falls in the grain tray instead of the ground.

Very comfy for sitting on the floor. It's meant for a smaller, lighter person, as I don't think the back could support anyone large or tall. The cushions are a bit stiff, but comfortable. I spend hours reading, gaming, and watching shows on it. My only wish is that you didn't have to fold the back entirely flat before setting it to the angle you'd like. Otherwise, very happy with it.
Really great value. Structurally I think you still need some angled corner brackets, especially since we used 12' 4x4s. I used 2x4s cut at 45 degrees
Very good quality easy to use made the job so much easier.
Commandé le 26 octobre livraison très bien et rapide je vais pouvoir travailler la terre de mon jardin merci Vevor bonne journée à bientôt cordialement
Conforme à mes attentes, le produit semble solide et pratique.
Bought 9 months ago. Was super easy to assemble. Solid construction. Easy to use, even for a small woman like me working on amending heavy clay soil. This is my favourite tool in the garden.

Perplexe dans un premier temps sur le site. Je chercher depuis longtemps un outil pour pouvoir travailler le sol de mon potager sans aller trop en profondeur et sans demander systématiquement a mon mari de le faire (il a bien plus de force que moi ) et bonne nouvelle je n'est plus besoin de son aide!! Ahah.super facile d utilisation sa m'a l'air bien solide et m'a permise d'effectuer mes travaux au potager efficacement en peu de temps.

Tines are a LITTLE thinner than what I'd want, but works great in my soil. I'd be concerned about bending in either heavy clay or rocky terrain. Handles appear very sturdy (dowel-reinforced fibreglass). Some slight alignment issues during assembly, but easily resolved with a drill. On the whole, I'm very happy with the purchase.
Had this for close to a year now, still working like the day it came.
It could be wider. It's a little prone to tipping. I go to flip it over all the time or maybe a heavier bottom. Still good. It's nice
